risks.risk: Missing or damaged rear panel, cables, or internal boards reducing scrap/parts value
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the unit showing ports, panel integrity, and any visible damage
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming rear panel and internals may be incomplete or damaged, at lowest scrap value

risks.risk: Physical damage to screen or casing not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles including screen close-up, sides, and back
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible additional cosmetic/structural damage beyond what is shown

risks.risk: Actual size/model affects scrap material value (copper, glass, weight vary by model)
risks.proof: Photo of the model/serial sticker on the rear or bottom of unit
risks.if_unproven: priced at generic small-to-mid CRT TV scrap value, lowest bracket given no model confirmation

proof_requests: Photo of the rear panel showing ports, serial/model sticker, and overall condition
A clip or photo attempt of powering the unit on to confirm the 'not functioning' claim
Photos from additional angles (side, top, screen close-up) to check for cracks or missing parts
Photo showing the full unit including any stand or base, and overall dimensions for scale
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as an LG-branded CRT television being sold explicitly as non-functional scrap/parts, so it can be priced at worst-case scrap value; the seller's own description aligns with a low-value, as-is sale, and no higher-value claim needs proof since none is being made beyond 'scrap'.
